title: Async QBR Dry‑Run: Initiative Health Pack & Scenario Runbook
creator: Anika Patel
description: Goal: Produce an asynchronous QBR dry‑run packet that combines initiative health summaries, top risks and mitigation lanes, and a scenario playbook for ask/decision time with execs. The packet should allow leadership to run through the readout without an in‑person rehearsal and surface the 3 highest asks per initiative (funding, hiring, policy). Deliverables: 1) Initiative Health Pack PDF (one page per initiative + metric sparkline), 2) Scenario Runbook (three escalation lanes with triggers and owners), 3) One‑pager that maps OKRs -> initiatives -> current confidence score.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Initiative pages include latest OKR metrics (trend, baseline, target), primary risk (with owner), and the concrete ask (cost/hiring/priority). 2) Scenario Runbook contains measurable triggers (SLO degradation %, ARR slip, infra cost delta) and fallback lanes for each trigger. 3) Packet reviewed by Engineering and Design and receives stakeholder sign‑off. 4) All links to dashboards and supporting PRDs validated and included.
stakeholders: PM: Anika Patel; Eng Lead: Marcus Li; Design: Priya Rao; GTM: Samuel Ortiz; Finance: Leah Kim; CTO liaison: Rui Mendes
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Metrics stale because analytics job lag -> Mitigation: snapshot dashboards and embed csv export. Risk: Initiative owners unavailable for review -> Mitigation: designate alternates and capture updates asynchronously. Risk: Exec asks ambiguous -> Mitigation: include templated ask format with required fields (impact, cost, timeline, decision needed).
